contentWidths.reading: centered single column, max ~640px; side gutters absorb extra viewport width
contentWidths.standard: centered, max ~1100px — dashboards and tables; gutters grow as the viewport widens
contentWidths.split: fills the content region — a fixed-width side rail + a fluid main pane
contentWidths.full: full-bleed, fills the viewport — no max-width (immersive)

shellNote: App Shell (app-shell.jsx) is the single source of truth for nav chrome: a 200px fixed sidebar (active item highlighted, user card pinned bottom, role-gated admin link) + a fluid content region. The admin console uses the same shell's AdminSidebar variant. Per-screen artboards inherit the shell unchanged and vary only the content region; each 'layout' below names which shell + active item wraps the content and which contentWidths token the content region uses.

artboards.description: Shared AppSidebar chrome, Dashboard active (accent icon + tinted row); user card pinned bottom. Non-admin, so the role-gated 'Admin panel' link is hidden — that absence is what distinguishes it from the admin demo.
artboards.layout: The shell itself (reference): 200px fixed sidebar + fluid content region. Sidebar width is constant at any viewport; only the content region flexes.

artboards.description: Same sidebar with Progress active and admin=true, so the role-gated 'Admin panel' link renders above the user card. Differs from dashboard-active by active item + the presence of that admin link.
artboards.layout: The shell itself (reference): 200px fixed sidebar + fluid content region.

artboards.description: ReadinessRing shown across every band of the colour scale (<50 poor, 50–64 warning, 65–74 medium, 75+ good; null renders '—' not-assessed). Ring fill, number and caption all derive from one score — colour is the single source of truth, not set per-instance.
artboards.layout: Component swatch (no shell): fixed-size ring specimens laid out in a row.

artboards.description: ReadinessBar (thin inline progress) and DomainBadge (dot + label + pct pill), both coloured by the same score scale. Reference for compact inline readiness; colour must track the score, not be hard-coded.
artboards.layout: Component swatch (no shell): specimens sized to their content.

artboards.description: DomainScoreRow list for per-domain breakdowns; rows flagged focus render a 'Focus' tag and a bolder label. Bar colour tracks the score scale.
artboards.layout: Component swatch (no shell): full-width rows within a fixed specimen card.

artboards.description: Wizard step 1 of 3. Vendor-grouped cert list; selecting a cert highlights it and enables Continue (disabled until one is chosen). Sidebar shows step progress; no Back on step 1.
artboards.layout: shell: Onboarding wizard (its own step-progress rail, NOT App Shell — this is pre-app); content: reading (centered single column).

artboards.description: Step 2. Study preferences — duration slider, difficulty defaults to adaptive. Continue advances; Back returns to cert choice.
artboards.layout: shell: Onboarding wizard; content: reading (centered single column).

artboards.description: Step 3, optional diagnostic. User either starts the diagnostic or skips; that choice branches which completion screen shows next (complete-with-diagnostic vs complete-skipped).
artboards.layout: shell: Onboarding wizard; content: reading (centered single column).

artboards.description: Landing when the diagnostic was taken — baseline readiness handoff showing a real initial score + domain baseline. Distinguished from complete-skipped by the presence of an actual readiness number.
artboards.layout: shell: Onboarding wizard; content: standard (centered result card, wider than the step forms to fit the baseline breakdown).

artboards.description: Landing when the diagnostic was skipped — completion summary with a nudge to take it later. Readiness shows not-assessed ('—') because no baseline exists yet.
artboards.layout: shell: Onboarding wizard; content: content (centered summary card).

artboards.description: Empty-dashboard edge case for a regular user with no certs enrolled; bypasses the wizard. CTA is enrol/browse. Differs from the admin empty state by that CTA (enrol vs configure a certification).
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Dashboard active; content: a single centered empty-state card (~500px) within the content region (the artboard frames the card only, but it lives inside the standard shell).

artboards.description: Empty-dashboard edge case for a first admin with nothing configured — CTA routes into cert setup rather than enrolment. Only the admin-oriented CTA distinguishes it from the user empty state.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Dashboard active; content: a single centered empty-state card (~500px) within the content region.

artboards.description: Home with 2 certs. The lowest-readiness cert gets the gradient hero card; the rest are standard surface cards. Status dots map directly to domain scores. Quick-start review CTA present.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Dashboard active; content: standard (hero card spans the content width, remaining certs stack below; gutters grow as the viewport widens).

artboards.description: Same layout scaled to 3 certs — one gradient hero (still the lowest-readiness cert) + two standard cards. Differs from two-certs only by card count/data, not layout rules.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Dashboard active; content: standard (hero + stacked cards).

artboards.description: Enrolled but zero sessions logged — readiness reads not-assessed ('—'), weak-areas empty, and the primary CTA is start-first-session rather than resume. Post-enrolment counterpart to the no-certs empty states.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Dashboard active; content: standard (single cert card in its not-assessed state).

artboards.description: Split-panel auth (brand left, form right). Email + masked password with an eye toggle for visibility, 'Forgot password?' link, SSO option below the divider. Submit idle; no error banner present.
artboards.layout: shell: none (pre-auth); split-panel — ~280px brand rail + form pane. The whole panel is capped (~780px) and centered; it does not stretch full-bleed as the viewport widens.

artboards.description: Same form after a failed attempt — a red error banner appears and the email field carries an inline error + red focus ring. The only difference from default is these error affordances; layout is identical.
artboards.layout: shell: none (pre-auth); split-panel — ~280px brand rail + form pane, capped ~780px and centered.

artboards.description: Account creation. The password field drives a live 4-segment strength meter + label. The Terms checkbox gates Create account (disabled until checked). SSO sign-up is the alternate below the divider.
artboards.layout: shell: none (pre-auth); split-panel — ~280px brand rail + form pane, capped ~780px and centered.

artboards.description: Reset-request step — single email field + 'Send reset link', with a back-to-sign-in link. Submitting transitions to the email-sent state (same route).
artboards.layout: shell: none (pre-auth); split-panel — brand rail + form pane, capped ~780px and centered.

artboards.description: Post-submit confirmation — success icon, masked destination email, Resend / use-a-different-email actions, 15-minute expiry note. This is the sent state of the same route as the request form.
artboards.layout: shell: none (pre-auth); split-panel — brand rail + centered confirmation pane, capped ~780px.

artboards.description: Reached only from a valid reset link. New-password strength meter + confirm field; the confirm field shows a green check when it matches. Submit sets the password and returns the user to sign-in.
artboards.layout: shell: none (pre-auth); split-panel — brand rail + form pane, capped ~780px and centered.

artboards.description: Post-registration link-sent screen — 24h expiry, Resend / different-email actions. The account is not yet active; this blocks continuing until the link is clicked.
artboards.layout: shell: none (pre-auth); split-panel — brand rail + centered confirmation pane, capped ~780px.

artboards.description: After the link is clicked — 'Account activated' confirmation with a Continue-to-setup CTA (routes into onboarding). Terminal success state of the verify flow.
artboards.layout: shell: none (pre-auth); split-panel — brand rail + centered confirmation pane, capped ~780px.

artboards.description: Split reading + quiz. An option is selected but not yet submitted — Submit is enabled, no correct/incorrect colour is shown, and the agent panel is idle. Correctness styling is deliberately withheld until submit.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Sessions active; content: split — reading/quiz main pane + a collapsible agent rail on the right, fills the content region.

artboards.description: After submitting a wrong answer — options reveal correct/incorrect colours and the agent auto-explains via a tool card. Distinguished from the answering state by the revealed colours + the agent explanation appearing.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Sessions active; content: split — reading/quiz pane + expanded agent rail (showing the explanation tool card).

artboards.description: Reading block expanded and the AI agent collapsed to a rail (both are user-toggleable). Quiz has progressed to a later question. Same screen, different panel emphasis.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Sessions active; content: split — reading pane widened, agent collapsed to a thin rail; the split ratio is what changes between session states.

artboards.description: Pre-session config, minimal chrome (no app sidebar). Quick start launches with saved defaults in one tap; a suggested focus is shown. A Customise affordance reveals the custom-config state.
artboards.layout: shell: none (minimal, no sidebar); content: content (centered config column, ~840px).

artboards.description: Expanded config — per-domain focus checkboxes plus duration/difficulty overrides. Distinguished from quick-start by the visible domain picker and override controls.
artboards.layout: shell: none (minimal, no sidebar); content: content (centered config column, ~840px; grows taller as options expand).

artboards.description: Full-screen, no sidebar or agent. Questions stream in and the timer stays paused until all are ready; Start is disabled meanwhile. No status colours yet.
artboards.layout: shell: none (full-screen exam mode, deliberately no nav); content: full — question pane + fixed right question-nav panel, fills the viewport.

artboards.description: Timer running, an option selected but not submitted. The right-hand question-nav panel tracks answered vs unanswered. Correctness is hidden during the exam.
artboards.layout: shell: none (full-screen exam mode); content: full — question pane + fixed right nav panel, fills the viewport.

artboards.description: Post-exam score breakdown by domain with a pass/fail verdict — revealed only after finishing. Entry point into review mode.
artboards.layout: shell: none (full-screen exam mode); content: full — results occupy the whole viewport (nav panel gives way to the domain breakdown).

artboards.description: Per-question review — correct/incorrect revealed with explanations. Read-only walk-through of the completed exam; no answers can change.
artboards.layout: shell: none (full-screen exam mode); content: full — question pane + right nav panel, fills the viewport.

artboards.description: Shown after a study session (20 min / 12 Qs). Readiness delta + domain accuracy; deltas use the status colour scale. 'Drill my misses' is the primary CTA.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Sessions active; content: standard (centered summary column).

artboards.description: Same summary template after a mock exam (1h 47m, 65 Qs, PASS). Same component as the study-session variant; distinguished only by scale of data + the pass verdict.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Sessions active; content: standard (centered summary column).

artboards.description: SRS entry point — items due grouped by domain with counts. Start begins the card loop. This pre-loop overview is what distinguishes it from the card states.
artboards.layout: shell: none (focused review loop, no sidebar); content: content (centered single card, ~780px).

artboards.description: Flashcard front — question + optional hint and a Reveal CTA. The answer and the rating buttons are hidden until Reveal is pressed.
artboards.layout: shell: none (focused review loop); content: content (centered single card, ~780px).

artboards.description: After reveal — answer shown plus Again/Hard/Good/Easy SRS ratings. The chosen rating schedules the next repetition and advances to the next card.
artboards.layout: shell: none (focused review loop); content: content (centered single card, ~780px).

artboards.description: End of the loop — session breakdown + next-due summary. Terminal state of the review.
artboards.layout: shell: none (focused review loop); content: content (centered single card, ~780px).

artboards.description: Historical view with 10 sessions — the readiness trend line is meaningful, domain bars use the status scale, full session history listed. Trajectory is visible.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Progress active; content: standard (centered column: activity summary, trend chart, domain bars, history table).

artboards.description: Same page with only 3 sessions — trend is not yet meaningful (short/flat) and history is sparse. Distinguished from with-history by data volume, not layout.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Progress active; content: standard (same centered column, sparse data).

artboards.description: Per-cert deep-dive with the Overview tab active — domain scores, stats, recent sessions. Breadcrumb back to dashboard. Switching tabs swaps content on the same route.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Dashboard active (drill-down; breadcrumb back to Dashboard); content: standard with a tab bar under the header; Overview content in the region.

artboards.description: Sessions tab active — full session-history table for this cert. Same route/screen as overview; distinguished only by the active tab and its content.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Dashboard active (drill-down); content: standard with the tab bar; Sessions table fills the region.

artboards.description: Settings with the Account tab active; app sidebar stays visible (Settings active). Editable profile fields. Tabs are client-side on one /settings route.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Settings active; content: reading (centered narrow column) beside the tab list, for comfortable reading.

artboards.description: Study Defaults tab — default duration/difficulty/domain focus applied to new sessions. Same route; distinguished by active tab + content.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Settings active; content: reading (centered narrow column).

artboards.description: Notifications tab — per-channel toggles. Same route; distinguished from siblings only by the active tab and its content.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Settings active; content: reading (centered narrow column).

artboards.description: Standalone tutor with no session context. A response is streaming — user bubbles use surface/secondary, agent bubbles primary/white. No tool cards (unlike in-session). Sliding 4h inactivity TTL.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Ask AI active; content: standard (centered chat thread, max ~760px) with a sticky composer pinned to the bottom of the content region.

artboards.description: New chat — empty thread with suggestion chips and a ready composer. Chips seed the first message. Distinguished from active by the absence of any messages.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Ask AI active; content: standard (centered empty thread + suggestion chips) with sticky composer.

artboards.description: Active chat idle ~12 min — a TTL expiry banner appears above the thread; sending a message resets the sliding 4h TTL. Only the banner distinguishes it from the active state.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Ask AI active; content: standard (centered thread) with a full-width expiry banner above it + sticky composer.

artboards.description: Admin landing reached before the setup wizard. Existing-certs table where Manage sources is the ONLY action (no status column, no edit/delete) + a due-for-re-verification table loaded with rows. 'New certification' routes to the wizard; each row's Re-verify opens the diff panel over this page.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: standard (page header + two stacked full-width tables in the content region).

artboards.description: Fresh install — the existing-certs table shows its empty copy 'No certifications have been set up yet.' and the due table is empty too. Distinguished from due-empty by the TOP table being empty (whole page is the zero-state).
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: standard (both tables render their empty rows).

artboards.description: Existing certs loaded; the due table is in its loading async state — 'Loading certifications…' with a spinner, no rows or Re-verify actions yet. One of the due table's three async states (loading / error / empty).
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: standard (top table populated, bottom table shows a centered loading row).

artboards.description: Existing certs present; the due table has resolved to empty — 'No certifications are due for re-verification.' Distinguished from existing-empty (top table populated here) and from the loading/error async states.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: standard (top table populated, bottom table shows a centered empty row).

artboards.description: The due table failed to load — 'Could not load certifications. Please try again.' with a Retry; the existing-certs table still renders normally. The error async sibling of the loading/empty states.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: standard (top table populated, bottom table shows a centered error row + Retry).

artboards.description: After clicking Re-verify — a modal 'Proposed changes' panel over the dimmed list. Field/Current/Proposed table where changed rows render the Proposed value in the primary colour and unverified fields carry a muted '(unverified)' tag. 'Accept all & re-verify' (primary; disables + shows a spinner while submitting) and 'Cancel'; an error line appears in the footer on failure.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: standard underneath, with a centered modal (~720px) overlaying the dimmed content region.

artboards.description: Wizard step 1 of 5 and the true entry point (reached from the 'New certification' button). The admin names the certification — certification name, exam code, certifying body, and an optional known source URL — before any search runs. 'Search for sources' kicks off the agent search and advances to step 2; no metadata is created until a source is approved there.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: below a step header — reading (centered ~640px form; exam code + certifying body sit side by side).

artboards.description: Wizard step 2 of 5. Agent-found candidate sources ranked by confidence with one pre-selected; manual-URL entry with Verify. Confirming triggers field extraction and advances to step 3.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: below a step header — reading (centered ~640px source list).

artboards.description: Step 3 of 5. Per-field list with a citation panel for the selected field — extracted value + highlighted source passage. Each field carries confirmed/unverified/pending status; Confirm walks field-by-field.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: split — fixed field-list rail + fluid citation pane, below the step header.

artboards.description: Step 4 of 5. Ingestion sources (ingested/ingesting/pending) + coverage bars against the 80% go-live threshold marker. Agent-proposed sources require explicit approval before chunks are extracted and embedded.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: two-column (sources list main + fixed coverage/readiness sidebar), fills the region below the step header.

artboards.description: Step 5 of 5. Summary of confirmed vs needs-attention fields + coverage, and a go-live readiness checklist. Publish is gated by a review checkbox; unverified fields stay hidden from learners until confirmed — you may publish now and resolve later.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: two-column (summary main + fixed publish/readiness rail), below the step header.

artboards.description: Full-page re-verification for a stale cert — warning header, per-field diff (current struck-through vs proposed) with per-row Accept plus Accept-all. Distinct from the /admin/certifications inline diff panel: this is the wizard-scoped full-page flow reached from a re-verify link.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Certifications active; content: standard (centered diff table under a warning header) — a full page, not the modal used on the list route.

artboards.description: Quarantine queue (left list) with one item selected (blue rail). The right pane leads with the verdict + recommended fix, then pairs the stored question against the highlighted source passage. Flag/verdict badges drive colour. Selecting a different list item swaps the right pane.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Review queue active; content: split — fixed ~320px quarantine-list rail + fluid detail pane, fills the content region.

artboards.description: Content-sources table for the selected cert. Per-source enable toggle, status pill (active/ingesting/disabled), Re-ingest/Remove actions. A running-ingestion banner (progress % + Cancel) appears only while a job is active.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Sources active; content: standard (cert selector + optional ingestion banner + full-width table).

artboards.description: User table with role badges. Promote/Demote flips the role; Remove is destructive (red). Search + Invite in the header. Admin rows are visually distinct from users.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Users active; content: standard (toolbar + full-width table).

artboards.description: Append-only, read-only event log. Each row shows a before→after transition; privileged actions are marked with a star. Rows have no actions (immutable); CSV export is the only affordance.
artboards.layout: shell: App Shell — Admin sidebar, Audit Log active; content: standard (meta row + full-width table).

stateCoverageNote: Per screen in 'screens': 'states' lists populated + the non-happy-path states (loading / error / empty). A value that names artboard state(s) means it is DRAWN; 'gap — …' means the behavior is specified here but no artboard exists yet. The 21 pre-existing screens are frozen (split-and-label only), so their missing states are documented rather than drawn — commission frames to close them. Admin Certifications (net-new) already draws loading / error / empty. 'n/a' marks screens/states that don't apply (e.g. auth forms have no initial data load — only a submit spinner).
responsiveNote: Desktop-first; every artboard is desktop-width. Narrow-viewport support is stated per screen. 'mobile out of scope' means the layout is not expected to reflow below ~1024px and no phone frames are specified. Auth screens are the exception — their split-panel collapses to a single form column on narrow.
contentBehaviorNote: Long/overflowing real-content handling is stated per screen. Defaults: single-line identifiers (emails, codes, filenames) truncate with ellipsis; multi-line prose and labels wrap; scrollable regions scroll within their pane, not the page.

screens.responsive: Reference only: 200px fixed sidebar + fluid content region.
screens.contentBehavior: Nav labels are short and fixed; the bottom user-card name truncates with ellipsis.

states.loading: gap — the cert list (step 1) and diagnostic questions (step 3) load: show skeleton rows / a loading question, Continue disabled
states.error: gap — cert list or diagnostic fetch fails: inline message + Retry, wizard holds the current step
states.empty: gap — no certs available to pick: 'No certifications available yet' with a contact-admin note (the drawn dashboard-empty-* frames are the no-cert app landing, not this)

screens.responsive: Desktop-first; the wizard column is already a reading-width single column so it centers acceptably on tablet; phone out of scope.
screens.contentBehavior: Long cert / vendor names wrap to two lines; the cert list scrolls within the step body.

states.loading: gap — cert cards load: 1 hero + N skeleton cards
states.error: gap — 'Couldn't load your certifications' with Retry; sidebar stays intact
states.empty: DRAWN — day-one-empty (enrolled, no sessions) + empty-no-certs-user / empty-no-certs-admin (no certs at all)

screens.responsive: Desktop-first; cards are full content-width and stack cleanly, but mobile chrome (sidebar → drawer) is out of scope.
screens.contentBehavior: Long cert names wrap (max ~2 lines); weak-area chips wrap to a new row; readiness numbers never truncate.

states.error: DRAWN — 'error' (bad credentials, banner + inline field error); submit-in-flight shows the spinner on the Sign in button
states.loading: n/a — no initial data load
states.empty: n/a

screens.responsive: Split-panel; on narrow viewports the ~280px brand rail drops and the form becomes a single full-width column (form-first). Supported down to phone.
screens.contentBehavior: Email + error text wrap; no truncation.

states.error: gap — field validation (email already in use, weak password) renders inline like Sign in's error; submit spinner on the button
states.loading: n/a
states.empty: n/a

screens.responsive: As Sign in — brand rail drops on narrow, form single-column.
screens.contentBehavior: Validation messages wrap beneath their field.

states.error: gap — send failure inline + Retry; Resend respects a cooldown
states.loading: n/a — submit spinner only
states.empty: n/a

screens.responsive: Brand rail drops on narrow; single-column form.
screens.contentBehavior: Masked destination email wraps.

states.error: gap — invalid/expired link: full-pane 'This reset link has expired' + request-new CTA; password mismatch shows inline
states.loading: gap — validating the token on load: brief spinner pane before the form
states.empty: n/a

screens.responsive: Brand rail drops on narrow.
screens.contentBehavior: n/a — fixed-length fields.

states.error: gap — expired/invalid verification link: 'Link expired' + Resend
states.loading: gap — verifying the link on load: spinner pane before the verified state
states.empty: n/a

screens.responsive: Brand rail drops on narrow.
screens.contentBehavior: Masked email wraps.

states.loading: gap — question + reading block stream in: skeleton reading + disabled options while loading
states.error: gap — 'Couldn't load this question' with Retry / skip; a separate agent-unreachable inline note in the rail
states.empty: n/a — a session always has content

screens.responsive: Desktop-only; the reading + quiz + agent split cannot usefully reflow below ~1024px — mobile out of scope.

states.loading: gap — saved defaults + domain list load: skeleton on the config column
states.error: gap — 'Couldn't load your defaults' inline + Retry

screens.contentBehavior: Domain labels wrap; a long domain list scrolls within the picker.

states.loading: DRAWN — 'loading' (questions streaming in, timer paused, Start disabled)
states.error: gap — 'Couldn't start the exam' full-screen with Retry / exit
states.empty: n/a

screens.responsive: Full-screen desktop; the question pane + fixed nav panel do not reflow — mobile out of scope.

states.loading: gap — computing the breakdown: skeleton delta + domain rows
states.error: gap — 'Couldn't load the summary' + Retry (the session is still saved)

states.loading: gap — the SRS due-queue loads: skeleton on the queue card
